purpose: Pinned external media tooling for wp00_media, wp00_export and WP09 production export. Spec 5.1: production export uses an explicit configured absolute path and verifies executable SHA-256 and capabilities against this file. Spec 9.11: no silent discovery of an unverified executable.
selection_policy: A probe resolves an executable path from config/default.toml, hashes the file at that path, and compares the digest to the matching entry below. A digest mismatch, a missing file, or a capability listed as absent here is a typed failure. No fallback to a PATH lookup is permitted.
vendoring: The .exe files in this directory are copied in by the operator and are git-ignored. They are inputs, not build output, and are never regenerated by a build.

executables.provenance: Copied 2026-11-04 from D:/ffmp/ffmpeg-9.0.2-essentials_build/bin/ffmpeg.exe. No download was performed; the same build was already present on this machine.

capabilities.verified_by: ffmpeg -hide_banner -encoders output read directly from the vendored executable on 2026-11-04
capabilities.not_verified: Capability lists are read from the build banner and encoder table. A capability marked present here is still probed at run time before use; this file is a declaration of intent, not a substitute for the probe.

notes: ffplay.exe was deliberately not vendored: nothing in the engine uses it.
Essentials build is GPL-enabled and static, so it has no DLL dependencies to stage.
WP00 needs a lossless or fast deterministic encoder for the raw-video probe; ffv1 is chosen over libx264 there because x264's default lookahead makes frame counts and timing less obviously exact.
